tools.name: delivery_schedule_create
tools.description: Open a delivery schedule against a quote, work order or change order and return its DS-YYYY-NNNN number: the reference, its own date, the client, a title and the currency. Free tier: 3 open.

tools.name: deliverable_add
tools.description: Add one deliverable to a schedule: what it is, the day it is due, and its value in whole minor units when it is separately priced. It starts as planned. Free on every tier.

tools.name: deliverable_status
tools.description: Record a dated move on one deliverable: planned to in progress, to delivered, and delivered to accepted with the acceptance note. Accepting something never delivered is refused. Free.

tools.name: deliverable_delete
tools.description: Delete a deliverable added by mistake. Only one still planned with nothing recorded against it can go: once it has been started or handed over it has a history. Free on every tier.

tools.name: delivery_schedule_get
tools.description: Show one schedule in full as at a date: every deliverable with its due date, status, delivered and accepted dates, acceptance note and value, plus what is late as at that date. Free.

tools.name: delivery_schedule_list
tools.description: List delivery schedules with their counts as at a date: what is late, what is still owed and what has been accepted. Filter by client, by reference and by whether the job is complete. Free.

tools.name: delivery_schedule_delete
tools.description: Delete a delivery schedule opened by mistake. Only one with no deliverables can go: once it carries one, it carries a record of what was owed. Free on every tier.

tools.name: late_report
tools.description: What has slipped as at a date you name: every deliverable still owed whose due date has passed, worst first, with the value at risk per currency and what was delivered late for the record. Free.

tools.name: delivery_schedule_document
tools.description: Render one schedule as a plain-text document for the client: every deliverable with its due date, status, delivered and accepted dates and value, the counts as at a date, and a sign-off block. Pro.

tools.name: milestone_payload
tools.description: Build the delivered-and-accepted deliverables as invoice_create-ready items in MAJOR units and quote_create-ready items in MINOR units, with VAT at the shared profile rate. Writes nothing. Pro.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

model.late_rule: late once as_of is PAST the due date and nothing was delivered by then; due on as_of is due_today, not late
model.date_floor: no due date and no status move may fall before the schedule reference_date
model.unpriced_deliverable: value_minor omitted means not separately priced; counted apart, never summed as zero, excluded by name from the milestone payload
model.money: integer minor units; computeTotals/currencyDecimals/formatMoney/daysBetween imported from @theluckystrike/mcp-invoice/lib, no arithmetic restated

ways_back_under_the_cap: accept the last deliverable, which completes the schedule
